name: Law, LLM (Boston)
disclaimer: NU Map is an independent, student-built planner. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially connected to Northeastern University. Data is scraped from Northeastern's public catalog and refreshed on a schedule; always confirm with the official catalog and an academic advisor.

legend.notes: Sentences quoted verbatim from the catalog page that state a condition we could NOT express as structure — exclusions ("Research courses may not be used"), eligibility lists, per-course grade minimums. A section can consist of nothing but these. Quote them; never infer from them that a particular course does or does not satisfy the section.
legend.creditsRequired: Semester hours the catalog states for a section whose courses it does not list. Do not add these into a program total: some restate credit that another section already counts.

requirementSections.title: Electives
notes: Students must take at least 20 credits of LAW electives if they took the foundational courses; they must take at least 24 credits of LAW electives if not required to take foundational courses. Courses taken to fulfill concentration requirements count toward the elective requirement.

concentrationOptions.title: Business and Commercial Law Concentration
concentrationOptions.label: Business and Commercial Law
notes: Complete at least two of the following:
Students must also complete a paper related to business and/or commercial law. To fulfill this requirement, a paper must satisfy the criteria of the JD rigorous writing requirement.

concentrationOptions.label: Human Rights and Economic Development
notes: Complete at least two of the following:
Students must also complete a paper related to human rights and/or economic development. To fulfill this requirement, a paper must satisfy the criteria of the JD rigorous writing requirement.

concentrationOptions.title: Intellectual Property and Innovation Concentration
concentrationOptions.label: Intellectual Property and Innovation
notes: Complete at least two of the following:

Students must also complete a clinic or paper related to intellectual property and innovation. To fulfill this requirement, a paper must satisfy the criteria of the JD rigorous writing requirement. A clinic that counts toward the four-course requirement may not be used to also satisfy this requirement.
